description: Default crop boxes computed by the unmodified 4.x dialog (CropBoxClass.setCropOptions -> getCropSelect -> updateCoordinates) for a fresh upload with no stored crop. `select` was written to #id_thumbs-0-crop_{x,y,w,h}; `setSelect` is the [x0,y0,x1,y1] box passed to Jcrop. `aspectExtentRaw` is getAspectRatioExtent output (Infinity as a string); `aspectExtent` is what getCropSelect saw after setCropOptions coerced Infinity to 0. `minSize` is calcMinSize(size) (required autos only); `deadLocalMinSize` mirrors the all-autos local that setCropOptions computes and never uses.

edgeCases.label: existing crop, violates the size aspect ratio
existing crop, string values as read back from the form
no jcrop instance yet, integral box
negative x and y are clamped by shrinking w and h
Math.round(-0.5) is -0, so no negative clamp fires
x rounds to a negative before clamping
w one under minSize snaps up
w two under minSize does not snap
negative clamp first, then minSize snap
w one over maxSize snaps down
